;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[Second Nagorno-Karabakh War]]
***The [[government of Armenia|Armenian]] Defense Ministry says that an [[Armenian Air Force|Armenian]] [[Sukhoi Su-25|Su-25]] [[fighter jet]] was shot down by a [[Turkish Air Force|Turkish]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16]] fighter jet, killing its pilot. [[Turkey]] says it is untrue. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54345622 (BBC News)] 
***Five more [[Azerbaijanis|Azerbaijani]] civilians are killed during Armenian fire in the country, bringing the death toll among Azeri civilians to 12. At least 35 others are wounded. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-armenia-azerbaijan-civilians-idUSKBN26K2NP (Reuters)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[September 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***A [[roadside bomb]] targeting a civilian bus kills at least 14 people, including five children, in [[Kajran district]], [[Daykundi Province]]. Daykundi is considered one of the safest places in the country; this is the second attack in Daykundi this year. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-166670 (TOLOnews)]

;Business and economy
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on airlines]], [[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**The [[United States Department of the Treasury]] reaches a deal with seven of the [[Major airlines of the United States|major U.S. airlines]] to allocate around [[United States dollar|$]]25 billion in loans from the $2.2 trillion budget approved under the [[CARES Act]] to assist in their financial recovery amid the pandemic. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/business/1994127/us-treasury-says-loan-deal-reached-with-seven-airlines-amid-crisis#:~:text=WASHINGTON%3A%20The%20US%20Treasury%20on,cuts%20amid%20the%20coronavirus%20crisis. (AFP via ''Bangkok Post'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands]] reports 3,011 new cases in the past 24 hours, a daily record since the beginning of the [[pandemic]], as the country imposes new measures to combat a second wave of infections, according to data published by the National Institute for Health (RIVM). [https://news.yahoo.com/netherlands-records-3-000-coronavirus-123612319.html (Reuters via Yahoo! News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****7,143 new cases are reported in the [[United Kingdom]] in the last 24 hours, the highest single day of reported cases ever since the beginning of the outbreak. Meanwhile, 71 [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]-related deaths are reported at the same time, the highest level since July 1. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-uk-records-highest-number-of-confirmed-cases-since-start-of-outbreak-12085306 (Sky News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
***[[Vice President of India]] [[M. Venkaiah Naidu]] tests positive for COVID-19. He is asymptomatic and [[quarantine]]d at home. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/coronavirus-venkaiah-naidu-tests-positive-for-covid-19/article32725693.eceP (''The Hindu'')]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***Results from Phase I trials find that the vaccine candidate from [[Moderna]] works well with older adults. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/health/2020/09/29/modernas-covid-19-vaccine-may-work-equally-well-older-adults/3575377001/ (''USA Today'')]
**The worldwide death toll from COVID-19 exceeds one million. The [[United States]] remains the largest contributor, accounting for 21% of the total deaths. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-54334496 (BBC News)]
*[[Animal welfare and rights in France]]
**[[Ministry for the Ecological Transition (France)|French Minister of Ecology]] [[Barbara Pompili]] announces that [[Fur farming#Mink|mink farms]] and the use of [[wild animal]]s in [[circus]]es will be phased out, and the breeding and importing of [[dolphin]]s and [[killer whale]]s at [[Marine mammal park|marine park]]s are banned effective immediately. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/france-wild-animal-ban-circus-marine-park-mink-farming-b694420.html?utm_source=reddit.com (''The Independent'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Hathras gang rape and murder]]
**A 19-year-old [[Dalit]] woman died in [[Delhi]] after she was allegedly [[gang rape]]d in [[Uttar Pradesh]] by four upper-caste men, sparking outrage in [[India]] from opposition parties. The woman was admitted to a hospital in Delhi two weeks ago with several serious injuries. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/09/29/asia/india-dalit-woman-gang-rape-murder-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-54335895 (BBC News)]
*[[Sexual violence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**The [[World Health Organization]] announces it will launch an investigation into the allegations regarding its officials committing acts of [[sexual exploitation]] and [[Sexual abuse|abuse]] while on mission to control the [[Kivu Ebola epidemic#2020 Équateur Province outbreak and other health problems|Kivu Ebola outbreak]] in the [[Province of Équateur|Équateur Province]] of the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://mb.com.ph/2020/09/30/who-says-probing-sexual-abuse-allegations-in-dr-congo/?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=who-says-probing-sexual-abuse-allegations-in-dr-congo (AFP via ''Manila Bulletin'')]
*A court in [[China]] sentences a woman [[capital punishment|to death]] for poisoning 25 kindergarten children with [[nitrite]] in their porridge, killing one. The court said the motives of the woman were "despicable" and "vicious". [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/09/29/china/china-kindergarten-poison-needles-intl-hnk-scli/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Togo]]
**[[Victoire Tomegah Dogbé]] becomes the first female [[Prime Minister of Togo]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/09/29/africa/togo-female-prime-minister-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Amnesty International]] says it has been forced to halt its [[India]]n operations due to "reprisal" from the [[government of India|government]]. Amnesty said its bank accounts were frozen and it was forced to [[Layoff|lay off]] staff, and suspend all its campaign and research work. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-54277329 (BBC News)]
*[[Emir of Kuwait]] [[Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah|Sheikh Sabah al-Sabah]] dies at the age of 91. Crown Prince [[Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah]] is named his successor. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-54340988 (BBC News)] [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/gulf/2020/09/29/Kuwait-names-Crown-Prince-Sheikh-Nawaf-al-Ahmad-al-Sabah-as-new-emir (Al Arabiya)]
